items.text: It's been almost 10 years since I've been here The wait was always too long this time it was only 15 minutes
items.source_text: It's been almost 10 years since I've been here. The wait was always too long but this time it was only 15 minutes. Ivan was our server, it was a pretty busy evening and he was hustling back and forth! Very attentive and checked on us frequently. We had the all you can eat soup, salad and bread sticks. Also tried the spaghetti. Overall pretty good food the gnocchi soup was our favorite! Tried the Tuscana and minestrone soup. The salad was fresh and flavorful, bread sticks were a bit dry but not too bad. I do remember them being incredibly good. Having good service makes all the difference especially when it's so crowded. But did enjoy our visit. Went back and tried the ravioli carbonara it was delicious! Huge portion!

items.text: A regular customer of yours Overall, this is a good place to eat Staff are courteous There are a few positive criticisms I would reduce the amount of dressing on the salad
items.source_text: A regular customer of yours. Overall, this is a good place to eat. Staff are courteous. There are a few positive criticisms; I would reduce the amount of dressing on the salad. Salads are supposed to be salads, not soups. The amount of cheese in eggplant parmesan needs to be reduced. It overpowers the eggplant flavor. kf2241943 1 opinión We ordered food delivered.Eggplant Parmesan and stuffed chicken We’re very good. Strangely, manicotti was ice cold, as if it had just been removed from freezer. Not crazy about their marinara sauce. It’s not really a sauce, but mainly a bunch of large tomato chunks. I checked three stars, but computer changed it to one star When I postedI don’t want to mislead anyone.

items.text: Aunque hay que esperar por una mesa, vale la pena, desde que llegas a pedirla la atención es buena
items.source_text: Aunque hay que esperar por una mesa, vale la pena, desde que llegas a pedirla la atención es buena. El menú es amplio y también cuenta con una hoja en la mesa con especiales. Pedí de ese menú y fue una gran sorpresa, porque armas tu platillo: escoges la pasta, el tipo de salsa y carne. Descubrimos que con esta variante puedes volver a pedir el mismo platillo las veces que quieras. La ensalada está deliciosa, en general todo lo que comí, la mesera fue muy amable. Al final nos llevamos algo de lo que nos quedó a casa.

items.source_text: Aunque hay que esperar por una mesa, vale la pena, desde que llegas a pedirla la atención es buena. El menú es amplio y también cuenta con una hoja en la mesa con especiales. Pedí de ese menú y fue una gran sorpresa, porque armas tu platillo: escoges la pasta, el tipo de salsa y carne. Descubrimos que con esta variante puedes volver a pedir el mismo platillo las veces que quieras. La ensalada está deliciosa, en general todo lo que comí, la mesera fue muy amable. Al final nos llevamos algo de lo que nos quedó a casa.

items.text: My wife and I haven't been to Olive Garden since the pandemic
items.source_text: My wife and I haven't been to Olive Garden since the pandemic. We had the best experience this evening. Our server Evelyn was very pleasant. Always comes around to see if we need anything unlike most servers who disappear and have to flag down all the time. Jonathan the manager was also very pleasant. Really nice guy to talk to. Olive Garden is such a joy to eat at. Delicious food and great hospitality. Bravo!
